Privacy policy

Effective from: 5 November 2026. Česky

Operator

[FILL IN: operator name], contact: [FILL IN: e-mail]. You can use this contact for questions and to exercise your rights.

Photos and designs

  • Photos are processed on your device. They are not sent to our server or to anyone else.
  • The app only receives the photo you choose. It cannot see your gallery or camera and does not read the location from the photo.
  • The photo is not stored after processing. Only the resulting outline and design settings are kept.
  • Designs and your library stay in your browser's storage. Clearing the site data deletes them. We do not back them up.

Visitor measurement

On the desktop version only, and only with your consent, we use Google Analytics from Google Ireland Limited to see how many people use the app. The legal basis is your consent. Without it, Google Analytics does not start. Advertising features are switched off. Data may be transferred to the USA as part of Google's services.

You can withdraw consent at any time with the Cookie settings button in the app. Your choice is stored in your browser and we ask again after a year. The mobile version does not use Google Analytics.

Hosting

The site runs on Webglobe hosting. As with any website, the server may record technical data during a visit, such as IP address and request time, for operation and security.

Your rights

You have the right to access, rectify and erase your personal data, to restrict processing, to data portability and to object. You can lodge a complaint with the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection (uoou.gov.cz).
